panels.title: kube api client requests
panels.description: Kube API requests the operator makes, split by method and response code. Scoped by namespace rather than app_kubernetes_io_instance: that pod label is not mapped into the metric by either annotation discovery or the PodMonitor, so selecting on it matches nothing. Requires the operator to be scraped via its PodMonitor (metrics.enabled + metrics.podMonitor.enabled), which is what supplies the namespace label. Window widened from 2m to 5m: at a 60s scrape 2m holds only the two samples rate() minimally needs, so a single missed scrape empties the panel.
Step-jump on any line = that pod was restarted or recreated (eviction, rollout, OOMKill). Catches both leader and follower restarts unlike restart counters which reset on eviction.
panels.title: Operator Start Time

panels.description: Counts OOMKill and crash-loop restarts within the same pod. Eviction-based recreates show as 0 here because a new pod starts with RESTARTS=0 — use Operator Start Time to catch those.
panels.title: Container Restarts

panels.description: Readiness of each konk (kube-apiserver) pod. Positive is ready, negative is not ready, so a pod flipping shows as a spike through zero. One series per pod, so pods replaced during the window each keep their own line -- repeated replacements of a single-replica Deployment show up here as a staircase.
panels.title: konks ready
KonkService count
panels.description: Total KonkService CRs known to the operator. Only Konk CRs were counted before.

panels.title: Etcd CR count
panels.description: Total Etcd CRs. Untracked before this panel.

panels.title: Operator 5xx error rate
panels.description: Operator reconcile failures against the parent Kube API. Sustained non-zero means reconciliation is failing. Reads "No data" rather than 0 while healthy: Prometheus only creates series for response codes actually observed, so with no 5xx ever returned there is no series to rate. Scoped by namespace rather than app_kubernetes_io_instance: that pod label is not mapped into the metric by either annotation discovery or the PodMonitor, so selecting on it matches nothing. Requires the operator to be scraped via its PodMonitor (metrics.enabled + metrics.podMonitor.enabled), which is what supplies the namespace label.

panels.title: Konk pod restart count (1h)
panels.description: kube-apiserver restarts per konk instance over the trailing hour.

panels.title: Provision pod ready
panels.description: provision writes /tmp/ready only when healthy. A failing probe means cert provisioning or renewal is broken.

panels.title: Provision uptime
panels.description: Long uptime means a stable renewal cycle. A low value means a recent restart.

panels.title: Provision restarts (24h)
panels.description: Each restart is a failed provisioning cycle.

panels.title: Provision restart history
panels.description: Correlate restart spikes with cert renewal windows.

panels.title: Days until PKI cert expiry
panels.description: provision-managed certs (~90d TTL). provision wakes 30 days before expiry to renew. Alert below 30 days.

panels.title: Next provision wake-up (days)
panels.description: Days until provision should next act. Below 0 means provision is overdue to renew.

panels.title: Self-signed issuer cert expiry (days)
panels.description: Expiry of bulk-konk-requestheader-self-signed, the long-lived (~2 year) self-signed issuer cert managed by cert-manager. NOTE: this panel previously tracked bulk-konk-ca, which cannot work -- that is a raw kubernetes.io/tls Secret created by provision/kubeadm, not a cert-manager Certificate, so cert-manager exports no metric for it. Cluster-CA expiry needs a different source (x509 parsing or a custom exporter); see spec 4.2.

panels.title: cert-manager Certificates not Ready
panels.description: Any row here is a Certificate cert-manager could not issue. Alert on any.

panels.title: KonkServices total
panels.description: Click through to the konk-services dashboard for per-service detail.

panels.title: Deployments unavailable
panels.description: kubeconfig or apiservice Deployments with no available replica.

panels.title: konk-service pods not Ready
panels.description: konk-service pods failing their readiness probe. Matches '.*konk-service.*'; the previous component-suffix regex missed pods whose names Kubernetes truncated.

panels.title: Min kubeconfig cert remaining (h)
panels.description: Worst-case kubeconfig client cert across the fleet. 12h TTL, so below 2h is critical.
